text: {"lessons":["I made no trades through both a sizable decline and a recovery, which reinforced that short-term moves alone are not a reason to act when prices are unpredictable.","I should set a suitable allocation and cash reserve in advance, then review them periodically rather than judging each stock by whether it is above or below its purchase price.","When I do trade, I should have a clear portfolio-level reason and respect my cash and share limits, instead of reacting to recent gains or losses."]}
